handoff.title: Finish on TikTok
handoff.inboxIntro: The video is already in the drafts of your TikTok account {account}. Kreo doesn't post it: you finish it on TikTok.
handoff.inboxSteps:
1. Open the TikTok app with the account {account}.
2. Tap the inbox notification (or go to your profile → Drafts).
3. Paste the caption below and check the hashtags.
4. Choose who can view it and, if needed, the commercial content disclosure.
5. Post it and come back here to click "I've posted it" (Kreo also detects it on its own within a few minutes).
handoff.manualIntro: Kreo couldn't send the video to TikTok ({reason}). It's ready for you to upload to the account {account}.
handoff.manualSteps:
1. Download the video.
2. In TikTok, tap "+" and choose the downloaded video.
3. Paste the caption below and check the hashtags.
4. Choose who can view it and, if needed, the commercial content disclosure.
5. Post it and come back here to click "I've posted it".
handoff.downloadHint: The link expires in 1 hour; reload the page if it does.
